# PeerFix

> A real-time help marketplace where builders post technical problems and get them solved — free from the community or paid via verified experts.

## What PeerFix does

- Builders post technical blockers with title, description, tags, and help type (free or paid)
- Community members respond to free problems and earn reputation
- Verified experts solve paid problems and receive 85% of the budget via USDC escrow on Base
- Platform takes 15% fee via smart contract
- Problems get unique URLs like /problems/00001/nextauth-session-drops-after-vercel-deploy

## Stack

- Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Supabase + Prisma (PostgreSQL)
- NextAuth v5 (Google + GitHub OAuth)
- Wagmi + Viem (Web3)
- Smart contract: PeerFixEscrow on Base Mainnet (USDC escrow)
- Resend (email)
- Vercel (deployment)

## Key pages

- / — homepage with live problem feed and stats
- /problems — browse all problems with filters
- /problems/new — post a new problem
- /problems/[id]/[slug] — single problem view with responses
- /expert/apply — apply to become a verified expert
- /expert — expert dashboard
- /dashboard — user dashboard
- /admin/experts — admin panel for approving experts
- /login — Google + GitHub OAuth
- /privacy — privacy policy
- /terms — terms of service

## Business model

Paid problems are funded via USDC on Base. The PeerFixEscrow smart contract holds funds until the problem poster accepts a solution, then auto-releases 85% to the expert and 15% to the platform treasury.
